summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Emporio Zeva (Not-A-Salami) refresh. 14/14 pytest cases green; all critical UI flows (nav, collection, product detail, inquiry, contact, newsletter, mobile menu) functional and integrated end-to-end with the API. No MongoDB _id leakage. No blocking issues.

issues: When /products/<unknown-slug> is visited, page silently stays in 'Loading…' state forever instead of showing a proper Not Found / redirect — minor UX issue, low priority

action_items: Consider adding a 'Not Found' state on ProductDetail when API returns 404 (currently sticks on Loading…). Low priority — not in spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Works, but worth migrating later.
server.py: POST /api/inquiries and /api/newsletter return 200; semantically 201 Created would be more accurate (minor).
ProductDetail.jsx silently swallows the 404 error from axios — page renders 'Loading…' indefinitely. Add an error state.
InquiryForm.jsx: success message uses #C05A3A (ember/cocoa) color on parchment — sufficient contrast, but visually identical to error state. Consider differentiating success vs error styling.
All files comfortably <200 lines, good separation, env vars used correctly (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL on FE, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME on BE). No hardcoded URLs found.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed inquiries and uniquely-suffixed newsletter subscribers via API during tests. Not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists); volume is minimal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_emporio_zeva.py and cover health, products (list + slug + 404 + available flag), inquiries (create, defaults, invalid email 422, list, no _id leak), newsletter (create, idempotency, invalid email 422, list). Pytest results exported to /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend manually exercised: home → collection (3 cards) → product detail (classic) → inline inquiry form submit → contact inquiry submit → our-story → journal → footer newsletter submit → logo back home → mobile menu toggle + nav. All data-testid attributes present and stable.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. Only enhancement opportunity: ProductDetail does not handle 404 from API (silent catch leaves Loading state). Reproduction: navigate to /products/anything-invalid. Mitigation: track an error state in ProductDetail's useEffect catch and render a 'Not found' block with link back to /collection.
